paragraphs: KloudGin sells work and asset management software to water and wastewater utilities. Gas utilities are a second market for the same platform. Municipalities and other public sector agencies are a third.

One part of the platform handles construction work management for complex projects, built on utility industry expertise. An enterprise asset management side unifies assets and workforce to optimize operations. Work management gives crews a view of assets, work orders, records and AI-native decision support. Prebuilt modules cover specific utility jobs such as automating fire hydrant maintenance. Others handle 811 ticket automation for dig requests. Another helps crews identify, document and replace lead service lines. GIS capabilities are embedded to support location-based customer service, and a separate adapter serves SAP customers.

An IDC MarketScape evaluation cited on the site names the company a Leader in utilities enterprise asset management. The company has announced a partnership with Black & Veatch. Its chief executive is named on the site as Vikram Takru. It also positions itself as a platform choice for cities.

quote.text: Connect your data, workforce, and customers with a fully configurable technology platform that delivers a complete view across your operations.
